[[Canal Winchester, Ohio]] }} '''B. J. Mullens''' (born in [[Canal Winchester, Ohio|Canal Winchester]], [[Ohio]], [[United States]]) is an American basketball player, formerly of the [[Ohio State Buckeyes men's basketball|Ohio State Buckeyes]]. ==High school== Mullens attended [[Canal Winchester High School]] and was ranked as one of the top college recruits in the nation from the class of 2008. He was ranked #1 in the nation by [[Rivals.com]] and #3 by Scout.com.[http://scouthoops.scout.com/a.z?s=75&p=9&c=4&pid=88&yr=2008 Scout.com Class of 2008 Basketball Rankings] Mullens was offered and accepted a scholarship to [[Ohio State]] by the Buckeyes' head basketball coach, [[Thad Matta]], in 2004, which was the summer between Mullens' 8th and 9th grade year.[http://hoopraker.com/2007/12/27/robbing-the-cradle/ Accepting OSU Scholarship] In his senior year he averaged 26 points and 15 rebounds,[http://insider.espn.go.com/ncb/recruiting/tracker/player?recruitId=43961&season=2008&action=login&appRedirect=http%3a%2f%2finsider.espn.go.com%2fncb%2frecruiting%2ftracker%2fplayer%3frecruitId%3d43961%26season%3d2008 Senior year Stats] including 29 points and 18 rebounds in his final high school game.[http://insider.espn.go.com/ncb/recruiting/tracker/player?page=briefingroom&recruitId=43961&action=login&appRedirect=http%3a%2f%2finsider.espn.go.com%2fncb%2frecruiting%2ftracker%2fplayer%3fpage%3dbriefingroom%26recruitId%3d43961 More Stats] He was a member of the 2008 [[McDonald's All-American Team]] and he was a part of the 2008 Jordan Brand Classic at [[Madison Square Garden]], where he had 12 points. ==College== In November 2007 Mullens signed a [[Letter of Intent]] to play basketball at [[Ohio State]]. Mullens was named to the Big Ten All-Freshman team and earned the Big Ten's Sixth Man of the Year award.{{cite web | last =Lesmerises | first =Doug | title =Turner, Buford, Mullens honored | publisher =''[[The Plain Dealer (newspaper)|The Plain Dealer]]'' | date =2009-03-10 | url =http://www.cleveland.com/osu/plaindealer/index.ssf?/base/sports/1236673991178760.xml&coll=2 | accessdate =2009-03-16 }} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *[http://www.ohiostatebuckeyes.com/ViewArticle.dbml?SPSID=87812&SPID=10421&DB_OEM_ID=17300&ATCLID=1568912&Q_SEASON=2008 Ohio State Bio] *[http://nbadraft.net/admincp/profiles/bjmullens.html NBADraft.net Profile] *[http://www.mynbadraft.com/NBA-Draft-Profiles-2009/BJ-Mullens MyNBADraft.com Profile] *[http://www.draftexpress.com/profile/B.J.-Mullens-1107/ DraftExpress.com Profile] {{DEFAULTSORT:Mullens, B.
